display_name: Phase1 锚定流对原恢复器的源样本配对诊断
description: 在相同源训练样本上比较固定 DURA 与已训练锚定流对干净基座判断的一致性及波形误差。
authorization: 用户要求研发更强星地恢复网络并严格限定 Phase1 地面训练、测试与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 基座。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch CPU only, original Phase1 frozen Tri-SIG-TIME release

data.representation: Phase1 R07 source IQ; matched DURA, anchored flow, and Tri-SIG-TIME
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels, V or test IQ; no network update

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s/U_s source IQ only; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME and DURA plus fixed anchored flow
permissions.claim_scope: In-training source teacher agreement only, not accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed anchored final E30, original frozen DURA and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact field metadata, DURA SHA256 and source ID/native IQ alignment
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Exact Phase1 original DURA and trained anchored field
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source records and views; no selection or optimizer update

execution.stop_rule: On mismatched source IQ/checkpoint or nonfinite output stop and preserve log; no automatic retry

metrics_plan.targets_ref: in-training source diagnostic, not TX accuracy

notes: 固定 512 个源训练物理记录（L128/U384），源视图 01 和 20，重复物理记录不可算作独立样本。
按物理 ID、角色和 clean IQ 对齐；使用原 DURA checkpoint 重算源 IQ，并检查原 native IQ 匹配。
按 clean Tri-SIG-TIME 判断统计两方法的修复/损伤、KL、归一化 IQ 误差；不使用 TX 真值、V 或测试 IQ，不更新网络。
这是模型训练期间使用过的源样本，一致性不是真实准确率；此前开发测试结果已观察，该诊断不证明独立泛化。

rows.method: DURA vs fixed anchored flow with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME
rows.purpose: Identify source conditions where trained anchored flow damages clean-teacher consistency
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source rows and views; deterministic fixed model
rows.budget_ref: 512 source IDs x 2 views, frozen inference only
